bugs_found: transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float/int inputs can raise TypeError or store inconsistent Receipt.amount types
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), which can produce incorrect results for non-integer inputs instead of rejecting them
